patthana16.54:1.1: Anidassanasappaṭighaṃ sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanasappaṭigho nasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anidassanasappaṭighaṃ sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho nasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anidassanasappaṭighaṃ sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho nasappaṭigho ca naanidassanasappaṭigho nasappaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi.
